19th Century London Stage:  An Exploration

Domestic Life in 19th Century England

Scope of the Project

Plays of Domestic Life

 Although 19th century England is perhaps best remember as a century which saw the development of legislation concerning labor and industry, industrialization profoundly effected domestic life as well.
Domestic issues were dramatized, if often superficially, by 19th century playwrights, and were of great interest to theatre-goers of the period.  

Many comedies performed on the 19th century London stage sugar-coated a bitter social pill,  forcing audiences to confront, if only a little, the domestic ills which plagued British society at every level.  These issues fall into four broad categories:
